name: get_balance
description: Return remaining VA hours, capRoom, and whether a new cap can be filed. Also returns the calls wallet: balance_cents is spendable after open holds, wallet_cents is that amount plus holds_cents, and holds_cents is the sum of unsettled holds. addFundsUrl is POST /api/v1/billing/add-funds and this read does not create a Stripe session. canDelegate is false when hours are unavailable, when spendable hours are not above zero, or when open caps leave no room. canDelegate false while hoursRemaining is above zero means lower maxHours to capRoom or wait. It is not a buy-hours signal. Call this before proposing spend. Does not create a task.

name: delegate_task
description: Call get_balance first, then confirm with the user before sending (real hours) unless they already said to send it. Delegate a task to a real human virtual assistant when the AI cannot complete it autonomously. Use this for phone calls, owner-authorized login or captcha steps (never send passwords or OTP), physical-world actions, subjective QA, manual data entry, or anything else outside the model's reach. Returns a taskId for tracking. The job is NOT started until the customer clicks Start on Work. The receipt status is awaiting_customer_start.

arguments.name: description
arguments.desc: Detailed context, instructions, and constraints (max 8000 chars). Never include passwords, OTP codes, recovery keys, cookies, or API keys.

arguments.name: dueDate
arguments.desc: Optional human-readable due date (e.g. EOD Friday).

arguments.name: sourceAgent
arguments.desc: Optional calling-agent label for the audit trail (e.g. grok-bot).

arguments.name: maxHours
arguments.desc: Spend cap in hours (default 0.5). VA/AM stop and ask before exceeding. Actual tracked time is billed, not this cap. Max 8.

arguments.name: idempotencyKey
arguments.desc: Same value as the REST Idempotency-Key header. Required. A repeat returns the original task.

name: list_tasks
description: List recently delegated tasks for this account (id, title, status, short result). awaitingCustomerConfirm true means the delivery is done and the human must confirm, cancel, or reopen. amNote is the delivery note and deliverableLinks are https links from that note. pending and in_progress omit customer-cancelled jobs. cancelled is terminal.

name: get_task
description: Get the current status, title, completion timestamp, and full result notes for a specific delegated task. awaitingCustomerConfirm true means ask the human, then confirm_task, cancel_task, or reopen_task. amNote is the AM or VA note. deliverableLinks lists https links. Stop when status is completed, failed, or cancelled. Customer cancel is cancelled, not pending or in_progress, and it does not send the completion webhook.

name: confirm_task
description: Accept a delivery that is awaitingCustomerConfirm. Settles tracked hours, releases the board and ledger hold, and marks the task completed. If the human does not respond, the job confirms itself after 3 days. Ask the human first. Idempotency-Key is required. A repeat of the same key returns the same result.

arguments.name: idempotencyKey
arguments.desc: Same value as the REST Idempotency-Key header. Required.

name: cancel_task
description: Customer never mind. Releases the hold and bills only tracked time. Does not send the completion webhook. Ask the human first. Idempotency-Key is required.

arguments.name: reason
arguments.desc: Optional note. Do not include secrets.

arguments.name: idempotencyKey
arguments.desc: Same value as the REST Idempotency-Key header. Required.

name: reopen_task
description: Send a delivery that is awaitingCustomerConfirm back to the account manager with a reason. Does not settle hours. Ask the human first. Idempotency-Key is required.

arguments.name: reason
arguments.desc: What should happen next. Required. Do not include secrets.

arguments.name: idempotencyKey
arguments.desc: Same value as the REST Idempotency-Key header. Required.

name: place_call
description: Place one human phone call. The hold is the full call: $2.50 for the first minute, then $1 for each additional minute. Default max_minutes is 5, so a tier 1 US or Canada call holds $6.50. An unused hold is a full refund. Raise max_minutes on that call to hold more. record_call must be false or omitted. Only US and CA are live. A question is {"id","ask","type"?}: id up to 80 characters, ask up to 1000 characters, at most 20 questions. goal is at most 4000 characters. Idempotency key is required. Poll get_call, or pass callback_url. validate_call checks the body and places no hold.

arguments.name: phone
arguments.desc: US or Canada number. 801-414-4664, (801) 414-4664, and +1 801 414 4664 are accepted and stored as E.164.

arguments.name: extension
arguments.desc: Optional digits. Passed into the VA instructions. Not billed.

arguments.name: language
arguments.desc: en, fil, tl, war, or ceb. Default en.

arguments.name: record_call
arguments.desc: False or omit. True is rejected: call recording is not available. get_transcript is the VA wrap-up summary, not a recording. A recorded transcript may be a separate paid feature later.

arguments.name: instructions
arguments.desc: Outranks script wording. The extension is appended for the VA.

arguments.name: questions
arguments.desc: One to 20 questions. Each item is {id, ask, type?}.

arguments.name: deadline
arguments.desc: ISO-8601. Needs 60 minutes of weekday 09:00–17:00 recipient-local, unless allow_outside_business_hours is true.

arguments.name: time_window
arguments.desc: Optional 24-hour HH:MM-HH:MM in the recipient time zone. Example: 09:00-17:00. End must be after start.

arguments.name: recipient_timezone
arguments.desc: IANA zone. Omit it and TaskBullet infers a US or Canada area code. An uninferable number needs this field.

arguments.name: allow_outside_business_hours
arguments.desc: Set true only after the customer confirms the call may happen outside weekday 09:00–17:00 in the recipient time zone. The deadline then needs 60 minutes of clock time. Omit or false keeps the weekday business-hour rule.

arguments.name: max_minutes
arguments.desc: Default 5. Maximum 60. The hold covers this many minutes.

arguments.name: idempotencyKey
arguments.desc: Same value as the REST Idempotency-Key header.

name: validate_call
description: Check a phone-call body without creating a call or placing a hold. Same fields as place_call, without idempotencyKey. A ready body includes hold_cents for the full call (tier 1 default $6.50 at 5 minutes: $2.50 for the first minute and $1 for each additional minute; an unused hold is a full refund) and whether recipient_timezone was inferred. valid stays true when spendable balance is below the hold. warnings then includes insufficient_balance with needed_cents and addFundsUrl.

name: get_call
description: Read one human phone call, including needs_info missing_fields, wrap_up, cancel_pending, refunded, or the final result.

name: get_call_events
description: Read the durable per-step event log for one call, oldest first. Each row has seq, kind, status, outcome, release_reason, and summary. summary is the VA wrap-up notes, or an auto-generated factual recap when ops sent none. A queued place_call appends call.placed (status queued) and then call.handoff_sent or call.handoff_failed. Replaying the same Idempotency-Key does not append those rows again.

name: update_call
description: Fill missing_fields on a call in needs_info. Same result shapes as place_call.

arguments.name: extension
arguments.desc: Optional digits. Passed into the VA instructions.

arguments.name: allow_outside_business_hours
arguments.desc: Set true only after the customer confirms the call may happen outside weekday 09:00–17:00 in the recipient time zone. The deadline then needs 60 minutes of clock time. Omit or false keeps the weekday business-hour rule.

name: cancel_call
description: Cancel a call. Status stays cancel_pending until ops confirms. A confirm before any dial refunds the hold and the status becomes cancelled. If the dial already started, the error is cancel_too_late and the call bills normally. A dial after a confirmed cancel is a full refund and the VA is unpaid.

name: get_transcript
description: Read the VA wrap-up summary for one call. This is not a recording. Once the call is wrap_up or completed, the result is that summary plus any question answers, with source wrap_up_summary and recorded false. Before a wrap-up summary exists, the result is transcript_not_ready. A call that ended without a dial (system failure or refund) is "no transcript: call not placed". A cancel after the dial started is call_cancelled. A recorded transcript may be a separate paid feature later and is not returned.
